game.label: A folder with your own copies of ChuChu Rocket!, loose or as ZIPs. A Dreamcast disc image alone is enough to play; iPad, iPhone or Android releases, the GBA ROM and the Dreamcast Express pack add more. Optional: put your own Dreamcast BIOS dump (2 MiB .bin) in the folder to match the original's clock and hint text exactly.

settings.label: Window mode
settings.help: Automatic opens full screen in Big Picture mode.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Synchronize drawing with the display to reduce tearing.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Choose crisp or smooth scaling for the original artwork.

settings.label: Look
settings.help: Dreamcast or mobile (iOS/Android) screens, menus and HUDs. Game default uses Dreamcast when its files were set up. It falls back to the other look when the chosen one was not set up.

settings.label: Sound
settings.help: Dreamcast CD music and effects, or the mobile releases' music and effects. Game default prefers Dreamcast and fills gaps from mobile.

prepare.label: Graphics, boards and music from your game files

options.label: Download Python and Pillow if needed
options.note: Setup uses these to extract assets from your own copies. On Linux and macOS it installs Pillow into a private environment (needs python3-venv and internet).

exit_codes.2: The game could not start. Check that Easy Setup finished and the extracted assets are still available.
